newsitem.title: INDIA: Suspected guerrilla mine kills 5 police in India.
newsitem.headline: Suspected guerrilla mine kills 5 police in India.

text.p: Five policemen were killed on Thursday when a landmine suspected to have been planted by Maoist guerrillas, blew up a vehicle in a police convoy in central India, the Press Trust of India (PTI) said.
The convoy was then ambushed by members of the outlawed People's War Group (PWG) near the town of Nagpur in the eastern section of Maharashtra state, the news agency said.
After a gunbattle, the guerrillas disappeared into the jungle.
The attack was believed to have been carried out in revenge for the death last week of a leader of the left-wing militant group, PTI said.
The separatist PWG controls parts of central India and regularly attacks police and paramilitary units.
